searchText: <@199561711278227457> <@412614104222531604> Can you point me in right direction please, how can I specify my own Besu log configuration file in the kurtosis configuration? Here is the snippet of my configuration, I am unable to figure out how to use/specify an external logging file for Besu: ``` participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth el_image: ethereum/client-go:latest - el_type: besu el_image: hyperledger/besu:develop el_log_level: "warn" el_extra_env_vars: {"BESU_XENABLE_EXTRA_DEBUG_TRACERS": "true"} cl: - cl_type: teku cl_image: consensys/teku:develop count: 1 network_params: preset: minimal ``` you can mount an extra configuration file using [el_extra_mounts](https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/blob/main/README.md?plain=1#L201) Thanks mate, that is super helpful. While we are at it, is there a way to deploy changed el_image without doing `kurtosis clean -a`? i.e. I build my besu image and I would simply like to redeploy the changed image instead of bringing the whole network down and bring it up again. Yes just change the image name and rerun targeting the same enclave name as before —enclave yourenclave just make sure you’re using a different local name, like besulocal1 then besulocal2

<@199561711278227457> <@412614104222531604> Can you point me in right direction please, how can I specify my own Besu log configuration file in the kurtosis configuration? Here is the snippet of my configuration, I am unable to figure out how to use/specify an external logging file for Besu:
```
participants_matrix:
  el:
   - el_type: geth
     el_image: ethereum/client-go:latest
   - el_type: besu
     el_image: hyperledger/besu:develop
     el_log_level: "warn"
     el_extra_env_vars: {"BESU_XENABLE_EXTRA_DEBUG_TRACERS": "true"}
  cl:
   - cl_type: teku
     cl_image: consensys/teku:develop
     count: 1

network_params:
  preset: minimal
```
